messages.text: How do changes in AI data centers technology affect the measurement capability required from Oscilloscope?

The knowledge base gave insufficient direct, raw-cited evidence for oscilloscope requirements in AI data centers. The following is therefore **general industry knowledge, not from the knowledge base**.

AI data centers are pushing oscilloscope requirements upward because the bottleneck is moving from compute chips alone to **high-speed electrical links, optical-module interfaces, memory buses, and power delivery**. Oscilloscopes used in this space need to measure smaller margins at much higher data rates.

### 1. Higher-speed interconnects require more bandwidth and lower jitter noise

AI clusters use faster links between GPUs, CPUs, NICs, switches, accelerators, memory, and optical modules. Examples include PCIe Gen5/Gen6, 800G/1.6T Ethernet, high-speed SerDes, CXL, DDR5/LPDDR5/possibly HBM-related interfaces.

This drives oscilloscope needs such as:

- **Higher analog bandwidth** for 32, 64, 112, and 224 Gb/s-class signals.
- **Very low intrinsic jitter** so the scope does not dominate the timing-error measurement.
- **High sample rate and deep memory** to capture long patterns, link training, burst behavior, and rare events.
- **PAM4 analysis capability**, since many data center links use multilevel signaling rather than simple NRZ.
- Eye diagram, bathtub, TDECQ, SNDR, jitter decomposition, and equalization analysis.

### 2. PAM4 and 224G-class SerDes make noise and linearity more important

With PAM4, the voltage spacing between symbols is much smaller than NRZ. That means the oscilloscope must have:

- Lower front-end noise.
- Better vertical resolution or effective number of bits.
- High linearity.
- Accurate clock recovery.
- Advanced de-embedding and equalization tools.

For 112G/224G SerDes, the raw signal at the receiver input may look badly closed until channel loss and equalization are accounted for, so the oscilloscope must support **CTLE/DFE modeling, fixture de-embedding, S-parameter embedding/de-embedding, and compliance applications**.

### 3. Shorter margins make fixture, probe, and de-embedding quality critical

AI server boards are dense and lossy: high-layer-count PCBs, backplanes, cables, connectors, sockets, interposers, and retimers all contribute loss, reflections, and crosstalk.

So oscilloscope capability is no longer just “bandwidth.” It also needs:

- High-performance differential probes.
- Low-loading probing.
- Accurate probe calibration.
- Fixture removal.
- S-parameter-based de-embedding.
- Channel emulation or embedding.
- Support for compliance fixtures.

In practice, measurement accuracy may depend as much on the probe and de-embedding workflow as on the oscilloscope mainframe.

### 4. AI accelerator power delivery increases power-integrity measurement demand

AI GPUs and accelerators have very high transient current. Fast workload changes can create supply droop, ripple, ground bounce, and PDN resonance.

Oscilloscope requirements therefore include:

- Low-noise power rail probes.
- High offset range with millivolt sensitivity.
- Fast transient capture.
- Frequency-domain view of ripple and noise.
- Correlation of power events with digital activity.
- Multi-channel time alignment across power rails, clocks, resets, and data links.

For AI servers, measuring only the average supply voltage is not enough. Engineers need to see nanosecond-to-microsecond droops and correlate them with link errors or compute load changes.

### 5. PCIe Gen5/Gen6 and CXL need protocol-aware compliance support

AI servers rely heavily on PCIe and increasingly CXL. As speeds rise, oscilloscopes need built-in or optional compliance applications for:

- PCIe transmitter tests.
- Receiver calibration support.
- Jitter and eye mask measurements.
- Link equalization analysis.
- CEM and base specification test coverage.
- Long pattern capture for training sequences and low-probability events.

PCIe Gen6 adds PAM4 and FLIT/FEC-related behavior, which increases the need for advanced signal integrity and protocol-adjacent debugging.

### 6. Ethernet and optical-module testing expands the scope role

AI data centers are rapidly moving to 800G and 1.6T optical and electrical interfaces. Oscilloscopes may be used for:

- Electrical host interface validation.
- Optical module electrical lane testing.
- PAM4 eye and TDECQ-type analysis.
- Jitter and noise characterization.
- Debugging host-to-module signal integrity.
- Correlating electrical impairments with optical link performance.

This requires high-bandwidth real-time or sampling oscilloscopes, depending on the test case.

### 7. More channels and synchronization are needed

AI server debugging often requires correlation across many signals:

- Multiple differential lanes.
- Reference clocks.
- Power rails.
- VRM control signals.
- Reset and sideband signals.
- Thermal or workload triggers.

So engineers need oscilloscopes with:

- Four or more high-bandwidth channels.
- Good channel-to-channel skew performance.
- External trigger support.
- Multi-instrument synchronization in some cases.
- Deep acquisition memory.

### 8. Debug is shifting from simple waveform viewing to system-level validation

In older systems, an oscilloscope might mainly confirm signal shape. In AI data center hardware, the oscilloscope increasingly supports:

- Compliance testing.
- Margin analysis.
- Root-cause debugging.
- Power-aware signal integrity.
- Time-correlated multi-domain analysis.
- Statistical analysis of rare failures.

That means software capability—compliance packages, jitter tools, serial decode, de-embedding, automation APIs—is as important as raw bandwidth.

### Summary

AI data center technology increases oscilloscope requirements in five main ways:

| Technology change | Oscilloscope impact |
|---|---|
| Faster SerDes, PCIe, Ethernet | Higher bandwidth, lower jitter, PAM4 analysis |
| Dense lossy channels | Better probes, fixtures, de-embedding, equalization |
| High-current AI accelerators | Better power-integrity and transient rail measurement |
| More complex standards | Compliance software for PCIe, Ethernet, DDR, CXL, etc. |
| System-level failures | More channels, deeper memory, automation, correlation tools |

In short: AI data centers require oscilloscopes that are not only faster, but also **cleaner, more accurate, more software-driven, and better integrated with signal-integrity and power-integrity workflows**.

ASMedia Technology Inc. › 來源中的說法
- [[Serdes IC-IP companies]]（來源正文未標示正式日期；raw 路徑含 2026-8-7；converted 2026-09-17）在台灣 IC 設計公司與產品方向名單中列出 [[祥碩科技]]，說其與 [[AMD]] 合作密切，產品涵蓋 USB、PCIe、SATA 等高速傳輸技術。
- 同一來源在公司簡介中說 [[ASMedia Technology Inc.]] 是 fabless IC design company。
- 同一來源說 ASMedia 成立於 2004 年，總部位於 New Taipei City, Taiwan。
- 同一來源說其專注於 high-speed interface technologies。
- 來源列出的產品與技術包含 USB host and device controllers、PCIe bridge controllers、SATA bridges and controllers、high-speed signal switches、ASIC solutions。
- 來源說 ASMedia 服務全球 motherboard 與 OEM companies。
- 來源說其市場據點包含 United States、Taiwan、China、Southeast Asia、Northeast Asia。
- 來源明確寫 ASMedia 具備 high-speed SERDES（Serializer/Deserializer）development 專業。
- 來源說 ASMedia 2012 年公開上市，並在 Taiwan Stock Exchange 上市，ticker symbol 為 5269。
- [[HighSpeedSerdesIC]]（來源未標示正式發布日期；converted 2026-09-17）在 **SerdesIC list** 的 PCIE 分類列出：企業 [[祥碩]]、English [[ASMedia]]、代號 `5269.0`、website 欄 `ASMedia Technology Inc.`。

Sentry HD High-Speed Backplane Connector › 來源中的說法
- [[full-spectrum-data-center-connectivity-brochure]]（來源未標示日期；raw converted 2026-09-17）在 featured product 區塊列出 Sentry HD High-Speed Backplane Connector。
- 來源稱 Sentry HD is Amphenol's next-generation high-speed backplane connector platform。
- 來源稱它 purpose-built to power the future of AI data center architectures。

高速互連 probing 與 de-embedding 測試案例 › 可學到的 sales / solution pattern
- 來源明示的 win factor 不是單一儀器規格，而是 total solution：probe、mount-kit、de-embedding tool 與 local partner。這與 [[R&S PCB test solutions]] 中 material measurement / sampling testing / process monitoring 的流程視角互補。
- Bare board for SoCs、socket / transmission line evaluation 與 board-to-board connector DUT 都落在 [[Signal Integrity]]、[[Insertion Loss]]、[[Return Loss]]、[[Impedance]] 與 de-embedding 的交界。
- Samsung 5G SoC including VCO case 顯示 [[R&S FSWP50]]、[[R&S SMW200A]] 與 automated VCO tuning software 可以被包裝成 RF / analog enablement 測試方案，但來源未提供正式 software product name 或 version。

- Operating system：Linux based operating system，目標為 high security 與 long-term support。

依 [[SMW200A_specs_en_3606-8037-22_v3100]]（Version 31.00，May 2026）與 [[SMW200A_config-guide_en_3606-8037-92_v0600]]（Version 06.00，May 2024）：

- [[R&S SMW200A]] 可從 single-path vector signal generator 擴充到 multichannel [[MIMO]] receiver tester。
- 支援最多 `8` 個 signal sources 與最多 `64` 個 fading channels。
- 可連接 [[R&S SGT100A]] signal generator modules，提供最多 `8` 條 RF paths。
- 最多可在 `2` 個 internal baseband modules 上配置 `8` 個 baseband generators，具 real-time coder 與 ARB。
- 單機可配置最多兩個 internal RF paths：RF path A 為 mandatory，RF path B 為 optional second RF path。
- Baseband section 分成 standard baseband section 與 wideband baseband section；standard baseband 最高 `160 MHz` RF modulation bandwidth，wideband baseband 最高 `2 GHz` RF modulation bandwidth。
- 可選 integrated fading section，channel emulation bandwidth 最高 `800 MHz`；最多可安裝 `4` 個 fading modules，提供最多 `64` 個 logical faders。
- 單一儀器可實作 MIMO fading scenarios：`2x2`、`3x3`、`4x4`、`8x4`、`4x8`、`2x4x4`。
- Path-specific、baseband-specific 與 fading/MIMO software options 採 floating license concept；若同一 feature 需同時在兩個 paths 或兩個 baseband generators 使用，通常需安裝兩份對應 option。

High speed SerDes eco-chain › 下游 — 終端應用與市場部署
- 通訊設備製造商：核心網、5G 基站、光傳輸設備、交換機、路由器等。
- 服務器與資料中心：協助 AI、高效能計算環境部署，需求高速內部連與介面連接。
- 網通基礎建設與雲端應用：包含物聯網、雲計算與邊緣運算等場域皆需高速數據傳輸與處理能力。
- 消費電子與車用領域：筆電 / 手機等需 [[HDMI]]、[[DisplayPort]]、[[USB]] 介面，汽車上的 [[ADAS]] 與 [[V2X]] 通訊亦需高速訊號傳輸。
- 工業與智慧製造：工業自動化系統、高速資料擷取與辨識也仰賴高速訊號鏈路。

R&S CMX500 › 產品定位
依 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]]，[[R&S CMX500]] 是 universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution，支援最新 3GPP [[5G NR]] technology，適用於 device testing，涵蓋 [[LTE]]、[[NR FR1]]、[[NR FR2]]，並支援 non-standalone（NSA）、standalone（SA）、FDD 與 TDD。

依 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]]，[[R&S CMX500]] 也提供：

- [[NR FR1]] / [[NR FR2]] signaling 與 TX measurements。
- [[LTE]] signaling、LTE-DTC / direct-to-cell communication、LTE measurements。
- [[NB-IoT]] / NB-NTN signaling。
- [[WLAN]] signaling 與 WLAN TX measurements，涵蓋 802.11a/b/g/n/ac、802.11ax、802.11be、802.11bn 與 2x2 MIMO。
- [[Fading]]、[[AWGN]]、[[BLER]]、[[CSI report]]、[[Throughput measurement]]、[[PER measurement]]。
- Application test、IP traffic analysis、IMS / audio / [[POLQA]]。
- GUI、graphical scripting、Python-based [[XLAPI]] 與 [[SCPI]] remote control。

ASMedia Technology Inc.
[[ASMedia Technology Inc.]] 是 [[Serdes IC-IP companies]] 中列出的台灣 fabless IC design company，來源稱其專注於 high-speed interface technologies，並具備 high-speed SERDES development 專業；[[HighSpeedSerdesIC]] 另以 [[祥碩]] / [[ASMedia]] 將其列在 PCIE 分類，代號欄為 5269.0。

Sentry HD High-Speed Backplane Connector › 可追溯限制
- 來源未標示正式內容日期、datasheet 版次、料號、支援速率、pin count、impedance、insertion loss、crosstalk 或 compliance 資訊。

answer.text:
AI data centers increase measurement relevance because servers and data centers for AI and high-performance computing require high-speed internal interconnects and interface connections [10].
High-speed SerDes applications explicitly include PCIe, Ethernet, USB, SATA/SAS, and MIPI, with Ethernet variants listed up to 800G [26].
AI data center connector technology is moving toward next-generation high-speed backplane platforms purpose-built for AI data center architectures [2].
The available R&S application context for high-speed interconnect validation is not oscilloscope-specific; it describes VNA, probe, mount-kit, de-embedding tool, and local partner solutions for PCB, socket, connector, and SoC validation [23].
The measurement domains explicitly tied to those interconnect cases are signal integrity, insertion loss, return loss, impedance, and de-embedding [3].
The passages support a “total solution” pattern rather than a single instrument-specification pattern for high-speed interconnect validation [3].
【推論】As AI data centers adopt higher-speed internal interconnects and interfaces, oscilloscope requirements would need to align with high-speed digital validation around PCIe/Ethernet/SerDes-class links, but the exact oscilloscope bandwidth or option set is not specified in the passages.[10][26]
【推論】Because the supported R&S high-speed interconnect context emphasizes probing, de-embedding, impedance, insertion loss, return loss, and signal integrity, an oscilloscope-based workflow would likely need strong probing and de-embedding capability, but this is not directly specified as an R&S oscilloscope requirement.[3][23]
【推論】For AI data center connector and backplane evolution, oscilloscope measurements would likely need to complement VNA-style channel characterization rather than replace it, because the cited R&S context centers on VNA plus probes and de-embedding for PCB, socket, connector, and SoC validation.[2][23]
